text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has invited me to help
with a
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should do it, I think. Just
look at this
bounty of vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The vegetarian diets of Buddhist monks
caught
my attention recently. My own
diet lacks
consistency, and I seem to
have put on a little
weight because of it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I figured I should increase my intake of
fresh fruits
and vegetables, and so I got
permission to help
with the harvests.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A change in diet clears the mind... It's
wonderful
what opportunities Japan has
to offer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can't wait to cook with these
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder comes up to me a few
days later
and happily tells me how her
new diet has been
working wonders.
